description: Chiral residual of GAP-A-2 at the AUDITED atomic nucleon and nuclear braids — D (H_6), T (H_9), ³He (H_9), ⁴He (H_12).  Computes ⟨c(λ)⟩_β at q_0 via two equivalent forms (direct sum + per-pair-symmetric) using the atomic-braid words from term7-alpha5-crystal-derivation.witness.json.  Tests whether the first-order chirality factor a_K(β) = 1 + w(β)·⟨c⟩_β·h matches the empirical (1+h)(1-h) = 1-h² pattern observed across these isotopes.
